description: Hyperbolic waveshaper, the same curve as the SHAPE control in Unfiltered Audio's Dent

params.text: Sets the curve, -5 to +5; noon passes the signal through, clockwise drives it towards a square and counter-clockwise pulls it into needles
Attenuverts the CV that shifts the curve, -1 to +1
Sets the voltage range expected at the input, 5V or 10V; the input is clipped to that range and the output scaled back out to it

inputs.text: Shifts the curve, through its own attenuverter

outputs.text: The shaped signal, within the selected voltage range
